title: Write the field repository into a form
summary: Brings the persistent fields of a text DFM, and their declarations in its unit, in line with the field repository as a change set, dry run by default
intro: Read this when a form should follow the field repository. drag-lint repo write-dfm prints the property changes of existing persistent fields and, for a field selection, the fields to add or remove; --apply or --select writes them with a backup, and a --select file must hold the plan id of the dry run its ids are from. Bytes outside a change stay, the new text is checked by Delphi's reader first. A missing field-event handler the repository holds code for is created, and a removed field takes its bound grid items: unchecked changes.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint repo write-dfm --dfm <file.dfm>[;...] [--dataset <Name> [--names <FIELD,...>|all]] --direction repo-to-dfm (--repo <file> | --project <project file>) [--apply | --select <id file>] [--dry-run] [--json]
help: drag-lint repo write-dfm      --dfm <file.dfm>[;...] [--dataset <Name> [--names <FIELD,...>|all]] --direction repo-to-dfm (--repo <file> | --project <project file>) [--apply | --select <id file>] [--dry-run] [--json]   (the property changes that bring the persistent fields of a text DFM in line with the repository, and with --names the fields of one dataset to add or remove, declarations in the unit included; a field event the repository holds code for and the form lacks becomes an unchecked new handler (DFM + method), a graphical row (FIELD_KIND 10) whose grid column the form lacks an unchecked new TcxGridDBColumn with its GRID_* handlers, and a removed field takes the grid / layout items bound to it as linked unchecked changes; every byte outside a change stays, the new text is checked by Delphi's own reader first, each changed file gets a backup; what cannot be settled is BLOCKED with the reason; the repository is only read; no --apply = dry run; a --select file needs the # plan line of its dry run; a binary DFM is refused; the project setting fieldrepo.bde (full | readonly | none, read per form: --project, else the _D-RAG at or above the form, else at or above the repository) closes BDE datasets and the plan names the policy and its source; exit 1 plan / write failure, a changed plan or a bad fieldrepo.bde value, 2 usage)

questions.command: drag-lint repo write-dfm --dfm <form.dfm> --direction repo-to-dfm --repo <file>   (then --select the ids of the unchecked OnGetText / OnChange inserts)

questions.command: drag-lint repo write-dfm --dfm <form.dfm> --direction repo-to-dfm --repo <file>   (then --select the ids of the unchecked TcxGridDBColumn inserts and of their OnGetDisplayText / OnCustomDrawCell handlers)
